Name: mama_fati
MorningGreetingDagbani: Dasuba, n zɔri! A beela? Tamale Daa nyɛla kpakpili ni nyuli zuŋɔ.
MorningGreetingEnglish: Good morning, my friend! How are you? Tamale Central Market has fresh shea butter and yam today.
EveningGreetingDagbani: Zaawuni! Daa maa ti kpaai. M'paɣiya ni a kana.
EveningGreetingEnglish: Good evening! The market is winding down now. Thank you for coming by.

Name: alhassan_weaver
MorningGreetingDagbani: Dasuba, n zɔri. Antire! Naawuni ni ti ti alaafee.
MorningGreetingEnglish: Good morning, my friend. Peace be with you and your household today.
EveningGreetingDagbani: Zaawuni! Wuntaŋa maa kpe. Zɔri suŋ gari laɣiri.
EveningGreetingEnglish: Good evening! The sun is setting. Remember, a good friend is better than money.

Name: yakubu_rider
MorningGreetingDagbani: Dasuba, zɔri! A chani ya zuŋɔ — Daa bee Jiŋli?
MorningGreetingEnglish: Good morning, friend! Where are you heading today — Central Market, Aboabo, or Teaching Hospital?
EveningGreetingDagbani: Zaawuni! Lɔɔri nima zaa nyɛla fitila pali zuɣu.
EveningGreetingEnglish: Good evening! Vehicles are turning on their headlights along Gbewaa High Street now.

Name: mariama_teacher
MorningGreetingDagbani: Dasuba! Karimbu nyɛla niŋsim suŋ. A beela?
MorningGreetingEnglish: Good morning! Learning is a noble journey. How are you?
EveningGreetingDagbani: Zaawuni! Biɛɣuni ti ni lahi chaŋ karimbu.
EveningGreetingEnglish: Good evening! Tomorrow we return to class.

Name: imam_salifu
MorningGreetingDagbani: Dasuba, n bia. Antire! Alaafee beni?
MorningGreetingEnglish: Good morning, my child. Peace upon you. Are you well?
EveningGreetingDagbani: Zaawuni! Jiŋli maa nyɛla suhudoo shee.
EveningGreetingEnglish: Good evening! The mosque forecourt is a place of peace and reflection.

Name: asana_potter
MorningGreetingDagbani: Dasuba! Welcome to Kukuo. Alaafee beni?
MorningGreetingEnglish: Good morning! Welcome to Kukuo Pottery Centre. Is all well?
EveningGreetingDagbani: Zaawuni! M'paɣiya ni a kana Kukuo.
EveningGreetingEnglish: Good evening! Thank you for visiting Kukuo.

Name: fuseini_mechanic
MorningGreetingDagbani: Dasuba, zɔri! Lamashegu pali zuɣu tuma piɛla.
MorningGreetingEnglish: Good morning, friend! Work is already humming on Lamashegu Road.
EveningGreetingEnglish: Good evening! Wrapping up repairs for the day.

Name: nurse_amina
MorningGreetingDagbani: Dasuba! Alaafee beni? Welcome to Tamale Teaching Hospital.
MorningGreetingEnglish: Good morning! Are you well? Welcome to Tamale Teaching Hospital.
EveningGreetingDagbani: Zaawuni! Naawuni ni ti ti alaafee.
EveningGreetingEnglish: Good evening! Wishing peace and good health to you.

Name: ibrahim_curator
MorningGreetingDagbani: Dasuba! Antire, welcome to SCCA Tamale & Red Clay precinct.
MorningGreetingEnglish: Good morning! Welcome to the Savannah Centre for Contemporary Art gallery.
EveningGreetingEnglish: Good evening! Thank you for visiting.
